summary: AngelPad remains active as a seed accelerator, but official site says applications are currently closed; future cohort dates are not published.

proposed_event.name: AngelPad Seed Accelerator
proposed_event.description: Selective seed accelerator investing $120K with hands-on mentorship and $300K+ in cloud credits.

dates.date_range_text: Applications currently closed; AngelPad says it selects about 15 teams every 6 months for an intensive 3-month program.

sources.title: AngelPad - #1 U.S Accelerator based in SF and NYC
sources.supports: Official site states AngelPad is a seed-stage accelerator based in NYC and San Francisco, selects about 15 teams every 6 months, runs an intensive three-month program, invests $120,000, provides more than $300,000 in cloud credits, and says applications are currently closed.

sources.title: Contact - AngelPad
sources.supports: Official contact page points founders to apply to join AngelPad and confirms AngelPad is ranked as a U.S. accelerator with alumni including Postmates, Buffer, Periscope Data, Drone Deploy, and Coverhound.

notes: The supplied angelpad.org URL redirects/currently resolves to the official angelpad.com site in public search results and official LinkedIn references.
No official 2026 cohort application open date, deadline, program start, end date, or demo day was found on the public official pages.
Because applications are closed as of the official site content checked on 2026-06-09, all exact date fields are null.
